mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that triggers Federal Reserve policy accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the 12 months following UNRATE > 8.5% triggers, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in fewer than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicate weakening demand in housing and consumer sectors, jointly causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS (product of z-scores) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of 20-day windows over a 3-year rolling period.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction regimes, declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In industrial contraction regimes, INDPRO declines fail to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Following CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% triggers, S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in fewer than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior three months indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in fewer than 45% of months when PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, declining real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand that reduces equity growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, RSAFS declines fail to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate broad economic slowdown across manufacturing and labor markets, jointly causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The INDPRO-UNRATE interaction (product of deviations) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of 60-day windows over a 3-year rolling period.
